learning_design.unlock_rule: A knowledge node unlocks after all required prompts are revealed.
learning_design.mastery_note: Exploration progress is not mastery evidence; quiz attempts remain the scored retrieval signal.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Subnets carve the VPC address space into __________.

reveal.text: Subnets carve the VPC address space into Availability-Zone-scoped networks for resources.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Internet reachability depends on routing and __________.

reveal.text: Internet reachability depends on routing and the resource’s addressing/security configuration.
CIDR sizing and available IP addresses matter operationally.
Route tables determine where subnet/ENI traffic is directed.
Routing chooses the most specific matching route.
Route tables. Check whether the destination has a route to the required NAT gateway, internet gateway, Transit Gateway, or other target.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Security groups control allowed inbound/outbound traffic __________.

reveal.text: Security groups control allowed inbound/outbound traffic and are stateful.
Stateful behavior tracks permitted connections.
Network ACLs support allow and deny entries.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Network ACLs filter traffic entering/leaving subnets __________.

reveal.text: Network ACLs filter traffic entering/leaving subnets using numbered rules.
Return-path ephemeral ports/directions must be permitted as required.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Security group: stateful, ENI/resource scope, allow rules | NACL: __________

nodes.title: Internet gateway, NAT, and egress-only IGW

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Internet Gateway: public IPv4/IPv6 internet path for addressed resources | NAT Gateway: __________ | Egress-only IGW: __________

columns.title: Internet Gateway
items: public IPv4/IPv6 internet path for addressed resources

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Private IPv4 instances need outbound internet updates, no inbound internet → __________.

reveal.text: NAT gateway. Place it appropriately and route private IPv4 outbound internet traffic through it.
Egress-only internet gateway. Use it for outbound-only IPv6 internet access from a VPC.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Gateway endpoint: route-table target for supported services such as S3/DynamoDB | Interface endpoint: __________

columns.title: Gateway endpoint
items: route-table target for supported services such as S3/DynamoDB

columns.title: Interface endpoint
items: ENIs powered by PrivateLink for supported services

reveal.text: A VPC endpoint is a key clue.
Use peering/TGW/VPN/DX for broader network connectivity patterns.
VPC peering directly connects two VPCs; routing and security must allow traffic.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: You cannot use one peered VPC as a transit __________.

reveal.text: You cannot use one peered VPC as a transit router for another peer.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Transit Gateway becomes attractive as connectivity grows __________.

reveal.text: Transit Gateway becomes attractive as connectivity grows into a hub-and-spoke topology.
Transit Gateway provides centralized routing among attached networks.
Transit Gateway can reduce pairwise connectivity complexity.
Troubleshoot both attachment state and Transit Gateway routing.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: WAF: HTTP(S) web request filtering | Shield: __________ | Network Firewall: __________ | Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall: __________

reveal.text: AWS WAF.
Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Network cost depends heavily on traffic path __________.

reveal.text: Network cost depends heavily on traffic path, transfer direction, and intermediaries.

prompts.label: ⚡ ACTION
prompts.placeholder: Evaluate endpoints, topology, AZ placement, CloudFront, and __________.

reveal.text: Evaluate endpoints, topology, AZ placement, CloudFront, and architecture against actual traffic.
Optimize cost within availability, security, and performance requirements.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: DNS records map names to values/targets according to record __________.

reveal.text: DNS records map names to values/targets according to record type and routing policy.
Alias records integrate directly with supported AWS targets.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Inbound: external/on-prem resolvers query Route 53 Resolver | Outbound: __________

columns.title: Outbound
items: VPC queries forwarded to external/on-prem DNS

reveal.text: Use Route 53 Resolver endpoints/rules.
It is for DNS query resolution/forwarding.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Weighted: split by configured weights | Latency: __________ | Failover: __________ | Geolocation: __________ | Geoproximity: __________ | Multivalue: __________

reveal.text: Weighted routing. Use configured weights to split DNS responses between endpoints.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Send users to Region with lowest latency” → __________.

reveal.text: Latency-based routing. Route users to the Region that provides the lowest measured latency.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Route 53 Resolver query logging records DNS queries __________.

reveal.text: Route 53 Resolver query logging records DNS queries from configured VPC resources.
Enable Resolver query logging for the relevant VPCs.
Use the log source that matches the question.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: CloudFront accelerates HTTP(S) content delivery and can protect/origin-shield __________.

reveal.text: CloudFront accelerates HTTP(S) content delivery and can protect/origin-shield applications with integrated features.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: CloudFront: HTTP(S) content caching/distribution | Global Accelerator: __________

columns.title: Global Accelerator
items: network acceleration to application endpoints using static anycast IPs

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Keep the cache key only as variable __________.

reveal.text: Keep the cache key only as variable as the application requires.

prompts.label: ⚡ ACTION
prompts.placeholder: Control freshness with TTLs, invalidations, and __________.

reveal.text: Control freshness with TTLs, invalidations, and versioned filenames/keys as appropriate.
Separate cache variation from origin forwarding needs.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Global Accelerator improves availability/performance for supported application endpoints using __________.

reveal.text: Global Accelerator improves availability/performance for supported application endpoints using AWS global network routing.
Global Accelerator is a strong clue.
CloudFront provides CDN caching.
Validate every hop and the return path; networking failures are often asymmetric.
Also inspect NAT/TGW/endpoints/firewalls and return routing where present.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Diagnose the actual blocking control and __________.

reveal.text: Diagnose the actual blocking control and preserve least privilege.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: VPC Flow Logs capture metadata for IP traffic at __________.

reveal.text: VPC Flow Logs capture metadata for IP traffic at supported VPC networking scopes.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Flow records help narrow down network __________.

reveal.text: Flow records help narrow down network path and security-control issues.
They are flow metadata, not packet capture.

nodes.title: ELB, WAF, CloudFront, and container logs

reveal.text: ELB access logs show load-balancer requests; WAF logs show web ACL decisions; CloudFront logs show edge requests; app/container logs show workload behavior.
Cross-layer correlation helps identify where the request failed.
Correlate request IDs/timestamps where possible.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Reachability Analyzer analyzes the configured path and identifies blocking/missing __________.

reveal.text: Reachability Analyzer analyzes the configured path and identifies blocking/missing components without sending packets.
VPC Reachability Analyzer is a strong diagnostic tool.
Use monitoring/synthetic/flow tools for live behavior.

nodes.title: Hybrid connectivity: Direct Connect and VPN

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Direct Connect: dedicated/private connectivity via DX location/partner | Site-to-Site VPN: __________

reveal.text: Validate both AWS and on-premises routing/security plus redundancy.
Direct Connect for a dedicated private connection; Site-to-Site VPN for encrypted IPsec tunnels over the internet.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Private connectivity requires both correct path __________.

reveal.text: Private connectivity requires both correct path configuration and authorization/service-specific settings.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Interface endpoint resolves publicly instead of privately → check private DNS and __________.

reveal.text: Endpoint configuration and VPC DNS settings. Verify private DNS is enabled where appropriate and that the expected hostname is being resolved.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Only supported endpoint services and configured endpoints are __________.

reveal.text: Only supported endpoint services and configured endpoints are available through that path.
Verify behavior/path pattern and which policy controls caching/forwarding.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Origin has new file but users still see old content” → inspect __________ cache behavior.

reveal.text: CloudFront cache behavior. Check TTLs, invalidation, cache keys, and the behavior that matches the request path.
Cached objects remain until expiration/invalidation/versioned URL changes.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Network Flow Monitor provides network flow performance visibility __________.

reveal.text: Network Flow Monitor provides network flow performance visibility for supported AWS workloads.
It complements VPC Flow Logs with performance-oriented monitoring.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Network Flow Monitor: network performance/health monitoring | VPC Flow Logs: __________

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Internet Monitor provides visibility into internet paths and end-user network __________.

reveal.text: Internet Monitor provides visibility into internet paths and end-user network performance for monitored applications.
Internet Monitor is a strong clue.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Use it for visibility/analysis; use Route 53/CloudFront/Global Accelerator or architecture changes __________.

reveal.text: Use it for visibility/analysis; use Route 53/CloudFront/Global Accelerator or architecture changes for remediation as appropriate.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Network Synthetic Monitor actively probes configured hybrid network paths, such as from AWS resources toward on-premises destination IP addresses, to __________.

reveal.text: Network Synthetic Monitor actively probes configured hybrid network paths, such as from AWS resources toward on-premises destination IP addresses, to measure latency and packet loss.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use it when you need proactive, repeatable monitoring of hybrid network connectivity instead of __________.

reveal.text: Use it when you need proactive, repeatable monitoring of hybrid network connectivity instead of waiting for real user traffic.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Choose based on whether you need generated tests or __________.

reveal.text: Choose based on whether you need generated tests or observations of real traffic.

authoring_notes: Original learning content. Official SOA-C03 exam guide revision 1.1 is the scope authority; the supplied May 2026 study guide was used as a supplementary coverage check and was not copied. Exam-clue prompts retain certification-style scenario wording and now reveal a direct answer first.
